snippet.title: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe is a point-and-click adventure game about a Giraffe attempting to live his day-to-day life while not talking to anyone. Can you make it through the week without talking to anyone as a giraffe living in the friendliest city in the world?

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071440/A_Week_in_the_Life_of_Asocial_Giraffe/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
